input.task: What is the title of the book edition by Arthur Cosslett Smith on this Open Library page?

provenance: third live domain (M6 live breadth). Edition pages are the stable unit on Open Library: a 1900 novel's edition record has no reason to change. Hand-verified 2026-08-17 with the eval-side probe: heading[0] is the edition title, heading[1] 'by Smith, Arthur Cosslett'. Chosen over a work page deliberately — see live-ol-work-title-dynamic in the triage of this batch: work pages render the title of a rotating featured edition (the probe caught /works/OL27482W, The Hobbit, titling itself 'Ka hopita', the Hawaiian edition), so a work-page title has no stable ground truth to hand-label. The anchor is the author surname, independent of the asked-for title. One page load per run.

triage.heading_0_note: unlike HN, Open Library exposes real headings, so this is tier-1-adjacent rather than purely positional — but index 0 still assumes the edition title is the first heading, which held on both edition pages probed. If OL restructures, red and loud.
